title: Poietic Agents
description: TLDR: Test whether initially identical agents can develop efficient shared data services and cheaper execution without losing fresh, correct answers. Compare with generalists, coherent caching and static specialists; count correct fresh on-time work and full lifecycle cost. S0-01 failed at the relay boundary after 36 calls; all 144 outcomes are retained and no model or swarm effect is established. Prepared S0-02 keeps models/thresholds with fresh cases, no retries and first-interface-error stopping. The owner has directed one bounded S0-02 continuation; renewal activation, exclusive allocation and central dispatch remain required. No new run has started. 81 offline checks pass. Original USD 2 cumulative cap and exposure remain unchanged; S1/S2 stay closed.
